verification_basis: Official ITU-T recommendation catalog records and corresponding ISO/IEC common-text edition identifiers.

normative_editions.scope: Core coding system, J2K/J2C codestream, and JP2
normative_editions.selection: Current consolidated common-text edition. Earlier amendments and corrigenda are consumed only through this integrated edition.

Current consolidated common-text edition. The locally hash-bound authoritative T.801 source recorded in source-provenance.json is the separately acquired 06/2021 publication; it supports the cited unchanged clauses but is not represented as a byte-for-byte copy of the 08/2023 consolidation. Edition-level traceability therefore combines the in-force ITU catalog record with that explicitly bounded source artifact.
Current conformance edition. Test assets require separate acquisition and redistribution review.

normative_editions.scope: JPIP interactivity tools, APIs, protocols, messages, databins, and cache models
normative_editions.selection: Latest approved common-text edition. The selected bounded profile implements binary messages, transactional databins, explicit and SIZ/COD/COC-derived precinct mapping, multi-tile packet reconstruction across all progression/POC orders, packed/length-header reframing, progressive selected quality-prefix decode, standard metadata/codestream placeholder assembly, and changing tile-part state with PLT or parsed exact Psot consumption boundaries as recorded in support-matrix.json. Cache-model signaling and network syntax are not selected and are not guessed; confirm the final in-force publication record before expanding the profile or release.

applicable_external_documents.topic: ICC profile interpretation and color conversion
applicable_external_documents.status: required before implementing ICC color management
applicable_external_documents.decision: First release parses and preserves bounded profiles but does not provide a color management engine.

Execution is pinned to the registry values already identified by the selected profile: 16 (sRGB), 17 (grayscale), and 18 (sYCC). The selected Part 1 and Part 2 editions define decoding behavior; later registry additions are not accepted implicitly.
